method: Fresh web searches followed by inspection of primary publisher/arXiv text. No external messages or submissions.
queries: "The Complexity of Reachability Problems in Strongly Connected Finite Automata"
"On shortest products for nonnegative matrix mortality"

primary_sources.title: The Complexity of Reachability Problems in Strongly Connected Finite Automata
primary_sources.checked: Sections 2, 7 and 9, also against the frozen local primary.txt. The global all-word definition and upper bound match the packet. Section 9 asks tightness without specifying fixed-k quantifiers.

primary_sources.title: On shortest products for nonnegative matrix mortality
primary_sources.checked: Sections 2.2, 3, 4 and 5. Section 4 gives the explicit binary deterministic queue/tail transition rule and quadratic mortality order. The general NFA exponential bounds lack the fixed global image promise. Section 4 attributes the n(n+1)/2 deterministic upper bound to Rystsov 1997; that original proof was not separately inspected.

primary_sources.title: A new lower bound for reset threshold of synchronizing automata with sink state
primary_sources.checked: v1, Section 2, definitions of appended physical tails and almost permutation automata, and Lemma 2.1 with proof. An h-state tail for h divisible by the permutation order adds n*h to the reset threshold. This is deterministic and does not provide the proposed compressed packet.

primary_sources.title: A new lower bound for reset threshold of binary synchronizing automata with sink
primary_sources.checked: Publisher first page confirms joint authors, title, journal pages 153-164 and deterministic sink reset scope. Full journal text was not obtained; no journal lemma number is asserted.

primary_sources.title: The Asymptotic Size of Finite Irreducible Semigroups of Rational Matrices
primary_sources.checked: Introduction, hypotheses, and Theorem 29: finite ordinary rational matrix semigroups. The candidate's b matrix has unbounded powers and so does not meet this hypothesis.

primary_sources.title: Quadratic bounds for uncompletable words and matrix mortality
primary_sources.authors: Rahul Chandelkar and Samrath Singh Chadha
primary_sources.checked: Abstract and Theorem 1.2: joint spectral radius at most one and a cycle hub in every support component. Both fail for the candidate. This theorem's full proof and claimed Lean development were not audited.

primary_sources.title: Andrew Ryzhikov: Research
primary_sources.checked: Current author's list for mortality/image-bound follow-ups, including the STACS 2026 paper; no full hierarchy resolution was identified.

primary_sources.title: Agentic Conjectures: Mortal words in small image-bounded NFAs
primary_sources.checked: Primary public record of its own finite enumeration claims: binary 2-image-bounded NFAs through four states. It explicitly limits its scope and leaves general asymptotic tightness unresolved. Its enumeration was not rerun and is not used in the proof.

access_failures.observed: Web tool cache miss; GitHub rendered README then opened successfully. This has no mathematical significance.

screen_result: No equivalent full fixed-k hierarchy theorem was found in the checked primary records and terminology searches. This bounded screen supports the stated novelty assessment; it does not prove exhaustive priority.
